operator_assessment.operator_summary: This export follows a narrowly scoped canonical arena-identity correction: the 23 Ringerike tournaments whose arena label was the venue's former name Ringerikshallen were re-emitted as Schjongshallen. No date, start time, host, participant, game, approval, change guard or guest reservation changed; deterministic verification is hard-valid (ok:true, zero violations) and every export format matches the plan. The REVIEW_REQUIRED verdict reflects pre-existing, unrelated publication-readiness gaps (12 unresolved tournament placements, participation-target deviations and underfilled U7/U8/U9 tournaments) that predate this pass and were deliberately left untouched.

key_tradeoffs.title: Identity-only correction, no replan
key_tradeoffs.summary: The migration rewrites only the arena string on the 23 affected Ringerike tournaments and re-emits the stored club->arena problem mapping; it does not move, rehost, resize or re-roster any tournament, so all previously reviewed placements are preserved.

key_tradeoffs.title: Pre-existing unresolved placements remain
key_tradeoffs.summary: 12 unresolved tournament placements (12/26/27 December date-policy exclusions and fixed external-calendar conflicts) and 38 underfilled U7/U8/U9 tournaments are unchanged by this pass and remain for operator follow-up.

remaining_actions.title: Pre-existing publication-readiness gaps untouched
remaining_actions.summary: Unresolved tournament placements (12) and the participation/underfilled findings are exactly as before this pass and are outside its scope.

limitations: This audit is scoped to confirming that the Ringerike arena-identity migration introduced no material change beyond the venue label; it does not re-review the pre-existing REVIEW_REQUIRED backlog.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Unchanged: only the arena label changed; no team's tournament count, opponent set or game list was touched. Participation-target deviation evidence is identical to the pre-migration export.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Unchanged: the 23 affected tournaments keep the same host club (Ringerike) and the same sibling representation; only the venue label changed.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: Unchanged: dates, start times, round counts and durations are byte-identical; the migration rewrites only the arena field.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: Unaffected by the identity correction: Schjongshallen is the same physical Ringerike venue as the former Ringerikshallen label, so calendar/source evidence and arena conflict intervals are unchanged.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification (ok:true, zero violations) confirms host-club participation is intact; the host club and roster of every affected tournament were preserved.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification passes with zero violations; no dates or participants changed.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: Unaffected: participant rosters are unchanged and the same-club distribution matches the pre-migration export.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: export_consistency_summary reports matches_plan: true with zero mismatches for csv_games, csv_overview, csv_team_counts, ical and excel; the fresh export contains Schjongshallen and no Ringerikshallen.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: No new material problem introduced. The only visible change is the canonical Ringerike arena label; pre-existing REVIEW_REQUIRED reasons are untouched.
